$comment: This file lives under scripts/, and .github/workflows/pr-review-signal.yml carries NO
path filter, so the job that reads it fires on every pull_request event regardless of
which files changed. That is deliberate: #3305's gate could not fire on the file it
guarded because that file was in no path filter, and a presence check that can itself be
filtered out is the same defect.
`reviewers` are the check CONTEXTS whose descriptions are adjudicated. Adding an
unrelated context here would make this gate opine on free text it has no business
reading; keep it to bot reviewers that claim a verdict on the code.
`phrases` are matched as case-insensitive PREFIXES of the description, and only against
a `success` state. `neutral` and `failure` already communicate 'no verdict'.

phrases.means: the reviewer hit its quota and read none of this diff
the reviewer declined to run at all
the reviewer was out of quota
the reviewer was out of quota
